cards.title: repeat()
cards.body: `text.repeat(n)` gives the text n times in a row.

cards.title: Lines that grow
cards.body: Use the loop counter to make each line longer than the last.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should print `ab`, `abab`, `ababab`, but prints `NaN` three times. Which line is wrong?

bug.fix: JavaScript cannot multiply text, so `"ab" * i` is `NaN` (not a number). Repeat it instead: `"ab".repeat(i)`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: i is 0 and then 1, so the lines have 1 and then 2 stars.
